title: OpenStax University Physics: Robotics Dynamics & Energy

sections.summary: Net external torque on a rigid body is equal to moment of inertia times angular acceleration.
Total mechanical kinetic energy consists of translational and rotational components.
Maximum static or kinetic friction opposes relative motion proportional to the normal force.

sections.topic: Actuator Electrical Power and Motor Torque
sections.summary: Mechanical output power equals shaft torque times angular velocity; electrical input is voltage times current.
